$comment: The shared contract for the ledger's CURRENCY. agent-team-template's currencyOf()/formatMoney() in scripts/lib/ledger.mjs and agent-cockpit's currencyOf()/formatMoney() in api/state.js make this judgement twice, mirrored by hand because there is no import path between a student's repo and a deployed web app. This is the fourth such mirror in this pair of repos, and the first about how money is printed: before it, three separate formatters printed a dollar sign for every student in every country and nothing could go red. Same bytes in both repos, run by both sides: change one implementation alone and that side fails.
rule: A currency is a short code with no whitespace, as the owner wrote it, trimmed. Anything else - a sentence, a number, a blank - is no currency at all. Money is the rounded number with thousands separators, then the code after it when there is one, and bare when there is not. Never a symbol, because the board is not allowed to guess.

codes.label: a symbol the owner chose to write is still a short code
absent is null, not a default
a sentence is not a code
a number is not a code
nine characters is too long to be a code

money.label: code after the number, thousands separated
a different code is printed as given
no currency prints the number bare, with no symbol
rounding is to the nearest whole unit
